decisions.statement: The key naming the file and the move of the type are one answer.
The file the type lands at is the `types` file beside the page type.
The type carried over is the one named for the page type's slug.
Every body importing the type that moved is repointed in this same answer.
What the carrying leaves is worked out by the module this change names.
A path naming no page is refused before any body is worked out.
A page that is no page type is refused before any body is worked out.
A page type stating that key already is refused by its path.
A page type declaring no type of that name gains the key and nothing is moved.
A types file holding no body is refused rather than written.
A page type whose type spells a key as a list of another type is refused.
A page type whose type spells a key as a union of other types is refused.
A page type is refused for either shape spelled in any type that page type extends.
The refusal names the key and the shape spelled and the file spelling it.
Nothing here writes the type the page type gains.

definition: one page type turned over to the code that writes its type
